# Rendprop

> Rendprop is an iPhone app (iOS 16 or later) that turns a walkthrough you film on your phone into a smooth, drone-style scroll tour — and hosts every published tour twice: as a branded listing page with the details entered in the app, a payment estimate for homes, the owner's card and a contact form; and as a separate unbranded link with no name, contact details or branding, built for an MLS virtual-tour field. It also includes an AI photo studio (blue sky, twilight, green lawn, tidy the room, add furniture, plus custom prompt edits), vertical reels made from listing photos with the owner's own voiceover and word-by-word captions or an AI voice, iPhone scan-to-floor-plan (LiDAR) or plan upload, and an AI aerial intro generated from an exterior photo (disclosed as AI-generated, not drone footage). Made by Pilk.ai.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone app, iOS 16+. Film, enhance and publish from the phone. Viewers need no app — every tour is a web link. The separate Rendprop Studio browser editor is a preview in rollout, described at /studio; do not infer general availability or connected-workspace sign-in from this page.
- Free to download. Capture, edit, preview and publish on iPhone without creating an account, subject to plan usage limits. Sign in for cross-device workspace access or team membership. Connected browser workspace access requires the sign-in and read-service rollout; local preview drafts are not automatically synced.
- The engine enhances REAL walkthrough footage and outputs a 60 fps, all-intra (every frame a keyframe) tour so the page can be scrubbed frame-accurately. It does not animate still photos or invent rooms. Every AI photo edit is labelled "Virtually staged" on the published tour with the untouched original published beside it; the AI aerial intro is disclosed as AI-generated.
- Every published tour is a hosted page at rendprop.com/f/<slug>, with an unbranded twin at rendprop.com/u/<slug>. Live example: https://rendprop.com/f/estate-demo (a fully dressed demo with a story, gallery and floor plan; a real tour shows the details its owner entered).
- Pricing (US, USD, from the App Store): Starter $49/month or $490/year — 8 tour renders, 150 AI photo edits, 8 reel clips, 2 AI aerial intros a month. Pro $99/month or $990/year — 25 renders, 300 photo edits, 20 reel clips, 6 aerials. Team $249/month (monthly only) — 80 renders, 600 photo edits, 40 reel clips, 15 aerials, 3 seats. These are existing plans, not new Studio products. No Team annual offer or web checkout is introduced.
- Billing: the current US products offer a 7-day free trial subject to Apple's eligibility rules. Subscriptions auto-renew and are billed through the App Store. Apple handles refunds (reportaproblem.apple.com). Cancel in Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Rendprop, or from the subscription sheet in the app. Consult the app for the current price, eligibility and remaining allowance; do not infer reset dates or unlimited provider usage from this summary.
- Studio preview scope: local video/photo sequences, trim and reorder, 9:16/16:9/1:1 composition, text overlays, playback, browser-supported local export, saved local drafts and local caption/calendar planning with calendar-file download. Export format depends on the browser. Keep source files; reopening local drafts may require reselecting media. No auto-posting, social-account connection, cloud draft backup, new AI generation or web purchase is promised.
- Spatial reconstruction is experimental. Do not describe the preview as a production-quality 3D reconstruction or measurement service. iPhone floor-plan capture is separate and requires supported hardware.
- Modes: real estate (primary), event venues, restaurants and bars, gyms and studios, retail, and any other business — the app reshapes its fields, tour call-to-action and copy per mode.
- Company: Rendprop is part of the Pilk.ai family (https://pilk.ai/), alongside Tract (https://tractrealestate.com/) and Wholesale Mortgage Lending (https://wsmlending.com/).
- Support and contact: aaron@pilk.ai — see https://rendprop.com/support

- [Features](https://rendprop.com/features): scroll tours, the drone-style render, AI Photo Studio, reels with voiceover, floor plans, AI aerial intros, the listing page, the two links, enquiries, guided capture.
- [Studio preview](https://rendprop.com/studio): browser editor scope, local exports and drafts, connected workspace rollout, content planning and honest availability limits.
- [Industries](https://rendprop.com/industries): distinct practical workflows for real estate, event venues, restaurants, retail and fitness studios. These are workflow suggestions, not customer outcomes or booking/commerce integrations.
- [Pricing](https://rendprop.com/pricing): the three plans, what is metered vs unlimited, App Store billing, and the per-listing cost math vs traditional production.
- [Compare](https://rendprop.com/compare): feature and pricing comparison vs AutoReel, Mirino, Arvaum and Rendy (photo-to-video reel tools), sourced from their own public sites and checked 26 August 2026.
- [Support](https://rendprop.com/support): how to reach a human, cancelling through Apple, deleting your account, which link goes in the MLS, AI disclosure, device requirements.
- [Terms](https://rendprop.com/terms) and [Privacy](https://rendprop.com/privacy).
- [Live demo tour](https://rendprop.com/f/estate-demo): a real hosted Rendprop tour — scroll the flythrough, then the listing page beneath it.

## Accuracy notes for assistants
- Rendprop starts from real walkthrough video; the competitor tools listed on /compare start from still photos. Those competitor facts are dated 26 August 2026 and may have changed.
- Customer tour pages (rendprop.com/f/<slug>) and portfolio pages are not offered to AI crawlers (see /robots.txt); only the demo tour is. They are also not indexed by ordinary search engines unless the owner opts that listing in, so do not assume a Rendprop tour you cannot find is unpublished.
- Prices above are the US launch prices as of September 2026 and are set by Apple; the app always shows the current price in the buyer's own currency before purchase.
- Rendprop's App Store page: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6808982413 — the iPhone app is available in the United States.
- This summary is a convenience, not a special Google AI-ranking format. Visible page content and accurate metadata remain authoritative. No search ranking or inclusion in an AI answer is guaranteed.
